items.description: 晚上走潮間帶或回部落時照路用。
items.descriptionEn: Lights the way at night on the tide flats or back to the village.
items.codex: 頭燈讓雙手空出來。夜晚觀察生物時，請把光壓低、別直射動物的眼睛。
items.codexEn: A headlamp keeps your hands free. When watching animals at night, keep the light low and don't shine it in their eyes.

items.description: 島上的陽光很強，下水和走潮間帶前先擦。
items.descriptionEn: The island sun is strong. Put some on before swimming or walking the tide flats.
items.codex: 選對珊瑚礁比較友善的防曬，或改穿長袖防曬衣。
items.codexEn: Choose a reef-friendly sunscreen, or wear a long-sleeve sun shirt instead.

items.description: 一瓶飲水，自己喝或帶給忙碌的家人。
items.descriptionEn: A bottle of water, for you or for busy family members.
items.codex: 在田裡、海邊工作時記得補水。島上的水得來不易，喝多少裝多少。
items.codexEn: Drink water when working in the fields or by the sea. Water is precious on the island — only fill what you'll drink.

items.description: 向租車行老闆借來的救生衣。
items.descriptionEn: A life jacket borrowed from the scooter rental owner.
items.codex: 下水、上船前都要穿好。海況不好時，族人也會說「今天不要下去」。
items.codexEn: Put it on before going into the water or onto a boat. When the sea is rough, Tao people will also say "don't go in today".

items.description: 飛魚季從海上帶回來的飛魚。
items.descriptionEn: Flying fish brought back from the sea in flying fish season.
items.codex: 飛魚是 Tao 文化的核心。怎麼捕、怎麼分、怎麼煮、何時停，都有規矩；遊戲只呈現族人同意公開的部分。
items.codexEn: Flying fish are at the heart of Tao culture. How to catch, share, cook them and when to stop all have rules. The game only shows what the Tao community agrees to share.
items.nutrition: 優質蛋白質、Omega-3（EPA/DHA）、維生素 D 與礦物質，是傳統飲食中重要的動物性蛋白來源。
items.nutritionEn: Good protein, omega-3 (EPA/DHA), vitamin D and minerals. An important source of animal protein in the traditional diet.

items.descriptionEn: Taro harvested from the taro field.
items.codex: 水芋是 Tao 的主食，由女性長輩帶領種植與照顧。田是家族的，要採之前一定要先問。
items.codexEn: Taro is the Tao staple food. Women elders lead the planting and care. Fields belong to families — always ask before picking.
items.nutrition: 複合碳水化合物、膳食纖維、鉀與維生素 B6；冷卻後帶有抗性澱粉。提供田間與海上勞動所需的穩定能量。
items.nutritionEn: Complex carbs, fibre, potassium and vitamin B6; resistant starch once cooled. Steady energy for work in the fields and at sea.

items.descriptionEn: Sweet potato. Filling and keeps well.
items.codex: 地瓜種在旱田，是水芋之外重要的主食。旅人多半在雜貨店買。族語名暫定，還要請族人確認。
items.codexEn: Sweet potatoes grow in dry fields and are the other main staple besides taro. Travellers usually buy them at the grocery store. The Tao name is provisional and still needs checking with the community.
items.nutrition: 地瓜提供澱粉、膳食纖維、鉀與 β-胡蘿蔔素（黃肉／橘肉品種較多），是飽足又耐放的主食。族語名 wakay 為暫定，還要請族人確認。
items.nutritionEn: Sweet potato gives starch, fibre, potassium and beta-carotene (more in yellow and orange kinds). A filling staple that keeps well. The Tao name wakay is provisional and still needs checking with the community.

items.descriptionEn: A yam dug up by the hills.
items.codex: 山藥口感滑順、好消化。採集的地點與時節還要請族人確認；族語名暫定。
items.codexEn: Yam is smooth and easy to digest. Where and when to dig still needs checking with the community; the Tao name is provisional.
items.nutrition: 山藥含澱粉、黏質多醣與鉀，口感滑順、好消化。族語名 ovi 為暫定（來源較弱），還要請族人確認。
items.nutritionEn: Yam has starch, mucilage and potassium. Smooth and easy to digest. The Tao name ovi is provisional (weak source) and still needs checking with the community.

items.description: 退潮時在潮間帶撿的貝類。
items.descriptionEn: Shellfish picked on the tide flats at low tide.
items.codex: 太小的不撿、只拿需要的量。哪些能撿、什麼時候撿，各部落有自己的規矩。
items.codexEn: Leave the small ones and only take what you need. Each village has its own rules on what to pick and when.
items.nutrition: 蛋白質、鐵、鋅與維生素 B12。族語名還要請族人確認。
items.nutritionEn: Protein, iron, zinc and vitamin B12. The Tao name still needs checking with the community.

items.descriptionEn: Seaweed picked on the tide flats.
items.codex: 退潮時在礁石上採。海菜含碘與礦物質，常和芋頭、地瓜一起吃。族語名還要請族人確認。
items.codexEn: Picked on the rocks at low tide. Seaweed has iodine and minerals and is often eaten with taro or sweet potato. The Tao name still needs checking with the community.
items.nutrition: 碘、鈣等礦物質與膳食纖維。族語名還要請族人確認。
items.nutritionEn: Iodine, calcium and other minerals, plus fibre. The Tao name still needs checking with the community.

items.description: 從紅頭望向小蘭嶼時提到的椰子。
items.descriptionEn: The coconuts mentioned while looking from Imorod toward Little Orchid Island.
items.codex: 小蘭嶼一帶的椰子常被族人一併提起。遊戲裡只看不採。
items.codexEn: Tao people often mention coconuts together with Little Orchid Island. In the game you only look, not pick.
items.nutrition: 椰肉提供中鏈脂肪與膳食纖維，椰子水含電解質。小蘭嶼一帶與椰子資源常被一併提及。
items.nutritionEn: Coconut flesh gives medium-chain fats and fibre; coconut water has electrolytes. Coconuts are often mentioned together with Little Orchid Island.
